name: Frame of Atiesh
label: Quest
description: Frame of Atiesh: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.
Find someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do not mourn their passing, friend. All such things are fated. Just as you holding the staff of the Guardian was fated...
